question: Which organisation organized the 54th National Safety Week in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Safety Council.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 54th National Safety Week was observed from March 4 to March 10, aiming to promote safety awareness and accident prevention across industries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Organized by the National Safety Council (NSC), a premier non-profit organization dedicated to safety awareness in India.**
 
• **The theme for 2025 was “Safety & Well-being Crucial for Viksit Bharat,”** aligning with India's 2047 development vision.
 
• Activities included safety drills, workshops, training programs, and public awareness campaigns.
 
• Emphasized workplace and public safety measures to reduce accidents and ensure a safe environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Safety Council (NSC)**__

 __
 
• Established in 1966 by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India.
 
• Aim: To promote safety, health, and environment-related initiatives across industries.
 
• Headquarters: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Labour and Employment**__
 __
 
• Regulates labour laws, workplace safety standards, and industrial relations in India.
 
• Oversees the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) and other worker welfare programs.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**__
 __
 
• India’s policy think tank, responsible for long-term strategic planning and economic reforms.
 
• Formed in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
 
 
• **Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)**__
 
 
• India’s national standards body, ensuring product quality and safety.
 
• Sets standards for industrial, commercial, and consumer goods.
